concerns.text: Tasks T301, T303, T304, T305, T307, T308, T309, T310, T311 in Phase 8 have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. T301 (geometric invariance) and T303 (stereoisomer) are orphaned work. T304 (hydration) and T305 (physical plausibility) violate FR-011 (out-of-scope experimental validation). These tasks must be removed or converted to documentation-only limitations to satisfy coverage.

Task T304 attempts to implement a 'hydration state sensitivity analysis' comparing gas-phase DFT to a theoretical hydration model. This directly contradicts Spec Assumptions ('hydration effects are out-of-scope') and FR-011. No spec element authorizes this implementation, creating a coverage gap where the task implements unauthorized scope.

Task T305 implements a 'physical plausibility score' checking against 'known bond types' (e.g., C=O ~2.3 D). FR-011 explicitly forbids physical measurement validation. This task has no matching FR/SC and violates the spec's constraint on ground truth sources.

Task T303 (stereoisomer breakdown) and T301 (geometric invariance test) are not traceable to any FR or SC. While the Plan.md Constitution Check mentions a 'Geometric Invariance Test' as an action plan, the spec.md does not include it as a requirement. Tasks must map to spec elements, not plan notes, to ensure coverage.

Phase 8 is titled 'Reviewer Response & Physical Rigor Enhancements' but contains tasks (T301-T311) that implement features not requested in the spec. This creates a 'stale tag' scenario where tasks reference a 'Reviewer Response' context that does not exist in the current spec.md, leading to untraceable work.
